evidence.title: Plasma - Developer SaaS/app template Next.js & Astro - Shadcnblocks.com

name: Plasma
summary: Paid Next.js and Astro template for a developer SaaS site, with landing, pricing, docs, changelog and download pages.
description: A 14-page developer SaaS/app template built on shadcn/ui and Tailwind 4, shipped in both Next.js and Astro editions. Pages are assembled from block sections and cover landing, pricing, docs, changelog, blog and download; content lives in MDX and JSON, docs use Fumadocs (Astro Starlight in the Astro edition), a Figma file is included, and the code is TypeScript with 100+ components.
contains: landing, pricing, docs, changelog, blog and download pages
docs built with Fumadocs (Astro Starlight in the Astro edition)
deployments tested on Vercel, Netlify and Cloudflare Pages
